description: Transcribe English speech in one local video (up to 180 seconds) using an English speech model on your computer. Optional in/out trim seconds; returned line times are source seconds. The transcript text is returned to your assistant/provider, so call only when the user wants to review or correct it. Media and transcript are never sent to Modisign. First use downloads the speech model; later calls work offline. Use captions.corrections in edit_video to fix names/phrases.
name: get_transcript
